body:
Use actual SoundRig failure modes to guide coding and review, and keep evidence for the revealed Qodo challenges.

Acceptance criteria:
- Root AGENTS.md explains architecture/setup/verification and 3-5 scoped rules with reasons.
- GitHub issue is read through the authenticated CLI and linked to one focused PR.
- Quality instructions require completed current-head Qodo review, all valid High/Medium findings resolved, Low findings flagged for human attention, test results and explicit disagreement reasons.
- The factory diagram distinguishes executed edges from planned or authentication-blocked steps.
- Incomplete/absent Qodo evidence is blocked, never marked complete; no automatic merge.
- Prepare daily Discussion drafts and a challenge/evidence ledger without publishing an entry.
title: Document project standards and bounded Qodo quality gates
